capabilities.body: OpenAmer vagsuek hong, yungh gij gungguek caen — cang minglingh, gij liuzlanj, vwnzgenh, daemjmaz — daeuj guh, caemh liuz gij banhfap miz yungh.
capabilities.title: Daihligj bouhbangj aen siengj

capabilities.body: Gij doiqvah, gij geiq’it caeuq mozyangh youq gwnz daiz gih neix. Cijmiz mwngz yieuq cij sengh cij uenx.
capabilities.title: Gij yiengngeih mwngz, gij soqcawj mwngz

capabilities.body: 186 cungj vah, moix cungj cungj yungh gij saw mwngz doeg. Naij yiemh daih’it yiengh vunghung cix cam mwngz senj cungj lawz.
capabilities.title: Gij vah mwngz, yungh ndaej hab

capabilities.body: Gij ginhyienh aeu ndaej congz hong caenhguh dauq cienz hwnj, yienghneix mwngz yungh ndaej naenz, hong binz ndaej raeuz.
capabilities.title: Gij laeg ningz ndaej sang

help: Gienz caz daiz gih neix ndaej raemx caeuq mungx.
Yungh cihvuengh yiet daeuq — gij bouh guh sat laeuj mbouj guh daeuq.
Danghnaeuz mbouj ndaej song baez, hai gij geiqloeg; gij hangz gvaqlaeng naeuz bouh lawz miz saeh.
failure.lead: Mbouj miz gij gaij bienq dawz dauq mbouj naeuz — OpenAmer dingz youq giz dingz, yienghneix yungh baez song cix caenh gij giz de gwnz guh daeuq.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer lij dwg banj gauh gaxgonq, lij ndaej yungh. Mbouj miz gij saeh aen vuenh ndaej faenh ndeu.
failure.title: Cihvuengh mbouj sat

language.lead: Cihvuengh yungh gij vah mwngz senj youq neix guh daeuq. Mwngz ndaej gajlaeng gaij youq ndaw vunghung.
language.title: Senj gij vah mwngz

progress.lead: Cihvuengh baez ndeu: OpenAmer dangx dawz gij souh yiengh de yieuq dauq caemh cihvuengh daiz gih neix. Gajlaeng hai mbouj guh daeuq.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer dangx vuenh banj gauh gaxgonq. Gij caezvah, geiq’it caeuq cihvuengh mwngz mbouj bienq.
progress.title: Dangx cihvuengh OpenAmer

stages.configure: Dangx cihvuengh gij bit API caeuq mozyangh
stages.dependencies: Dangx caeuq gij bouh Python yieuq
stages.gateway: Dangx hai dou caeuq swenj saenq
stages.node-deps: Dangx caeuq gij bouh Node.js yieuq
stages.platform-sdks: Dangx caeuq gij SDK daiz saenq
stages.uv: Dangx caeuq gij guenj bau uv

cards.body: Hai vunghung caemh naeuz mwngz yieuq guh gijmaz. OpenAmer guh hong youq laeng caemh dauq naeuz mwngz.
cards.title: Yungh gouq vah ndeu haijcingj

cards.body: Cihvuengh → Hienj → Vah. 186 cungj vah, seizlawz cungj ndaej vuenh.
cards.title: Senj gij vah mwngz

cards.body: Gij hong guh daeuq binz ginhyienh — baezlaeng minglingh diuz ndeu cix ndaej.
cards.title: Haeujsaeh de geiq ndaej

success.command: roxnaj gajlaeng hai de congz cang minglingh:
success.lead: Gij souh cungj ndei lo. OpenAmer seizneix dwg gij mwngz — youq gwnz daiz gih neix, yungh gij vah mwngz.
success.title: OpenAmer cingj ndei lo

bullets: Yungh youq daiz gih neix — gij doiqvah mwngz liuz youq daiz gih neix
186 cungj vah, caeuq gij saw mwngz doeg
Gijmaz gajlaeng cungj ndaej gaij; mbouj miz gijmaz dingh raeuz
welcome.lead: Daihligj mwngz bonjfaenh. Youq gwnz yiengngeih mwngz. Yungh gij vah mwngz.
welcome.leadUpdate: OpenAmer banj moq cingj ndei lo. De vuenh banj gauh gaxgonq caemh liuz moix aen caezvah caeuq cihvuengh.
welcome.note: Yungh gij mungx bingzseiz yieuq geij faenz cung.
welcome.title: Ndaej nienz daeuj OpenAmer
